name: GlobalEntity API
description: One REST API for official company data across 50+ European business registers (Brønnøysund, Companies House, CVR, Handelsregister and more) plus the global GLEIF LEI index. Send a company name and country, or a registration number, and get back a single normalized company object — legal name, registration number, address, legal form, status, industry (NACE), VAT and LEI — regardless of which country the data comes from. One integration replaces dozens of per-country connections: we handle registry access, normalization, deduplication and LEI/VAT/EORI resolution, and keep it maintained as registers change. Responses are cached for speed and reliability.
